title: Erase
description: A handwritten Beatles setlist taped above a ledge, one song already half rubbed out. Click any song to rewrite it in your own words, then scrub it with a real eraser: the ink lifts off as fine dust that drifts into a pile at the foot of the page, and undo pulls every grain back into its letter.
intent: Writing and erasing as matter: type a title and it is inked onto the sheet by hand, rub it and the energy becomes ink dust and eraser crumbs that heap up with a real angle of repose, undo is the dust flying home.
